Name: Genderswap Female characters.
Author: SleepyHer0
Description:
[b]Hey! [/b]If you haven't read the short description yet, [b]this mod changes the portraits of all female characters available for marriage to male gender.[/b]I would like to say that I rarely draw pixel art, so I do not pretend to be correct, and nevertheless I hope you like it!

This is my first mod, so if you find any bugs, let me know![b]Also, if I have a desire, I will make a full version with the replacement of all sprites and maybe something else, so stay tuned![/b]
